play.definition: A vertical double-move pass concept in which the primary receiver releases upfield, breaks toward the sideline to sell a standard out route, then plants and redirects vertically along the boundary. The route is designed to make the defender drive toward the out break or surrender vertical leverage before the receiver accelerates upfield for a deep pass.

action.label: Ball Snap
action.definition: The action of the center (or occasionally another player) legally putting the ball into play by handing or tossing it between their legs to a backfield player (typically the quarterback) to initiate a down.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Pass Block
action.definition: An offensive lineman or other offensive player's action to protect the quarterback from defensive rushers, establishing a pocket and preventing sacks or pressure.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

action.label: Pump Fake
action.definition: A quarterback's deceptive partial throwing motion intended to make defenders react as though a pass will be released while the quarterback retains possession of the football.

action.label: Run Go Route
action.definition: A receiver's vertical continuation after selling a stop or other underneath break, accelerating back upfield to complete the double-move route.

action.label: Sell Out
action.definition: A receiver's deceptive route action that presents an outside-breaking route through body lean, head position, and an apparent break toward the sideline before redirecting to the actual route.

action.label: Snap Receive
action.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.

action.label: Throw Pass
action.definition: A quarterback's or other eligible passer's action of propelling the football forward with a legal throwing motion toward an intended receiver.
